'''Solah''' was a call of surrender in [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] training [[Velocities/Legends|velocities]] at the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]]. It was looked upon as a sign of weakness by [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].
